questions.question: Aarif, Arun and Abraham can do a work in 12, 20 and 24 days, respectively. They all begin together. Arun leaves the work 3 days and Abraham 6 days before its completion. In how many days is the work finished?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Aarif, Arun and Abraham can do a work in 12, 20 and 24 days, respectively.

They all begin together. Arun leaves the work 3 days and Abraham 6 days before its completion.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total time taken by them be x days

Now,

LCM of 12, 20, and 24 = 120 i.e total work

So, efficiency of Aarif = 120/12

⇒ 10

Efficiency of Arun = 120/20

⇒ 6

Efficiency of Abraham = 120/24

⇒ 5

According to the question,

x × 10 + (x - 3) × 6 + (x - 6) × 5 = 120

⇒ 10x + 6x - 18 + 5x - 30 = 120

⇒ 21x = 120 + 48

⇒ 21x = 168

⇒ x = 8

**∴ The required time is 8 days.**

questions.question: A conical vessel, whose internal radius is 20 cm and height is 27 cm, is full of water. If this water is poured into a cylindrical vessel with internal radius 15 cm, what will be the height to which the water rises in it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Internal radius of vessel = 20 cm

Height of vessel = 27 cm

**Formula used: **

Radius = r and h = height and l = slant = height

Volume of cone = 1/3 × πr²h

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation: **

Volume of conical vessel = (1/3 × π × 20² × 27) cm³

Volume of cylindrical vessel = (π × 15² × height) cm³

Then, (1/3 × π × 202 × 27) = (π × 152 × height)

Height of cylindrical vessel = 16 cm

**∴ water rises by 16 cm.**

questions.question: The average age of six members of a family is 40 years. If the age of a guest is included, then the average age increases by 12.5%.What is the age (in years) of the guest?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

The average age of 6 members of a family is 40 years.

If the age of a guest is included, then the average age has increased by 12.5%.

**Concept used: **

Average = Sum of elements/number of elements

**Calculation: **

Sum of the age of 6 members of a family = 40 × 6

⇒ 240 years

If the age of a guest is included, then the average age has increased by 12.5%,

The average age of 7 persons = 40 × 112.5/100

⇒ 45 years

Sum of the age of 7 persons = 45 × 7

⇒ 315 years

Age of guest = 315 – 240 

⇒ 75 years

**∴ The age of the guest is 75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The average age of six members of a family is 40 years,

After the addition of 1 member, the average age increases by 12.5% the average age becomes = 40 × 9/8 = 45 year 

The difference of average age is (45 - 40) = 5 year

So, the guest brings (5 × 7) = 35 year age extra

So, the age of the guest is (35 + 40) = 75 year

questions.question: If α, β are the roots of 6x² + 13x + 7 = 0, then the equation whose roots are α², β² is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

6x2 + 13x + 7 = 0

**Concept used:**

We know that a quadratic equation whose roots are α and β is given by x² - (α + β) x + αβ = 0

**Calculation:**

6x2 + 13x + 7 = 0

⇒ x2 + 13x/6 + 7/6 = 0

So, (α + β) = - (13/6)

αβ = 7/6

Now,

(α + β)² = α² + β² + 2αβ

⇒ 169/36 = α2 + β2 + 7/3

⇒ 169/36 - 7/3 = α2 + β2

⇒ (169 - 84)/36 = α2 + β2

⇒ 85/36 = α2 + β2

Now,

x² - (α2 + β2)x + α²β² = 0

⇒ x2 - 85/36x + 49/36 = 0

⇒ 36x2 - 85x + 49 = 0

**∴ The required answer is 36x2 - 85x + 49 = 0.**

questions.question: A policeman spotted a thief 40 metres ahead of him. The moment they both saw each other they started running in the same direction on the same track. The thief was running at 10 m/sec and the policeman was chasing him at the speed of 12 m/sec. How much distance (in metres) the policeman needed to cover to catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A policeman spotted a thief 40 meters ahead of him.

The thief was running at 10 m/sec and the policeman was chasing him at the speed of 12 m/sec.

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

When two bodies move in the same direction then the Relative Speed = Difference of Speeds

**Calculation:**

The relative speed of police and thief = 12 - 10

⇒ 2 m/sec

Now,

Total time taken to catch the thief = 40/2

⇒ 20 sec

So, distance traveled by the police = 20 × 12

⇒ 240 m

**∴ The policeman needed to cover 240 meters to catch the thief.**

⇒ cos θ = sin2 θ

⇒ cos² θ = sin4 θ

⇒ sqrt{2cos²θ}

questions.question: Raghav went to a shopping mall to purchase clothes. He had two coupons with him, but only one can be used on a single day. Using the first coupon, a total discount of 30% could be obtained on the total amount. Using the second coupon, he will get 80% off on the price of the costliest shirt if he buys at least 3 shirts. What is the price at which Raghav can purchase 3 shirts at a minimum price if the prices of the three shirts are Rs. 1,250, Rs. 1,540 and Rs. 1,375?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The prices of the three shirts are Rs. 1,250, Rs. 1,540 and Rs. 1,375

**Concept used:**

Marked price × (100 - Discount)% = Selling price

**Calculation:**

For 30% discount:

Actual cost price = (1250 + 1540 + 1375) × 70%

⇒ 4165 × 70%

⇒ 2915.5

For 80% off on the price of the costliest shirt:

Actual cost price = 1250 + 1540 × 20% + 1375

⇒ 1250 + 308 + 1375

⇒ 2933

So, Raghav can purchase shirts at a minimum of Rs . 2915.5

**∴ The required answer is Rs. 2915.5. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__****Given:**

Prices of 3 shirts: Rs. 1,250, Rs. 1,540 and Rs. 1,375

Two choices of discount: 30% off the total price or 80% off the costliest shirt (with the condition that he buys at least 3 shirts)

**Calculation:**

Total cost without discount = Sum of the prices of all shirts

⇒ Rs. 1,250 + Rs. 1,540 + Rs. 1,375 = Rs. 4,165

With first coupon: Total cost = (1 - 30%) × Total cost without discount = 70% of Rs. 4,165 = Rs. 2,915.5

With second coupon: Total cost = Total cost without discount - discount on costliest shirt

⇒ Rs. 4,165 - 80% of Rs.1540 = Rs. 4,165 - Rs. 1,232 = Rs. 2,933

**∴ Raghav can purchase the 3 shirts at a minimum price of Rs. 2,915.5 using the first coupon.**

questions.question: A dishonest dealer sells the goods at 7% loss on cost price but uses 18% less weight. What is his percentage of profit? (Correct to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss% (a) = 7%

Less weight (b) = 18%

**Formula used:**

Profit% / Loss% = (b ± a) / (100 - b) × 100

**Calculation:**

As, a = 7% and b = 18%

Then,

Profit% / Loss% = (b ± a)/(100 - b) × 100

⇒ (18 - 7)/(100 - 18) × 100

⇒ (11/82) × 100

⇒ 13.4146 ≈ 13.41%

**∴ The dealer’s profit% is 13.41%.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 0 and x² + y² + z² = 40, then what is the value of xy + yz + zx?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 0

x2 + y2 + z2 = 40

**Concept used:**

(x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculation:**

x + y + z = 0

⇒ (x + y + z)² = 0²

⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 0

⇒ 40 + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 0

⇒ 2(xy + yz + zx) = - 40

⇒ xy + yz + zx = - 20

**∴ The required answer is - 20.**

questions.question: A sum of money doubles itself in 7 years at simple interest. In how much time will it become 5 times of itself?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum of money doubles itself in 7 years at simple interest.

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

P = (P × 7 × R)/100

⇒ 1 = 7R/100

⇒ R = 100/7

Now,

4P = (P × T × 100)/(7 × 100)

⇒ 28P = PT

⇒ 28 = T

So, time = 28 years

**∴ The required answer is 28 years.**

questions.question: If a 7-digit number 54p3987 is divisible by 11, then p is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

54p3987 is divisible by 11

**Concept used:**

If the difference of the sum of alternative digits of a number is 0 or divisible by 11, then that number is divisible by 11 completely.

**Calculation:**

5 + p + 9 + 7 - 4 - 3 - 8 = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ 21 + p - 15 = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ 6 + p = 0 or multiple of 11

For p = 5 we get 11

So, p = 5

**∴ The required answer is 5.**
